name: Bottled Lightning
description: On a successful Bottled Lightning attack, apply off-guard for 1 round.

name: Tanglefoot Bag
description: On a successful Tanglefoot Bag attack, apply clumsy 1 for 1 minute.

name: Thunderstone
description: After a Thunderstone Fortitude save, apply deafened for 1 round on a failure or 1 minute on a critical failure.

name: Alchemist's Fire
description: On a successful Alchemist's Fire attack, apply 1 persistent fire damage.

name: Acid Flask
description: On a successful Acid Flask attack, apply persistent acid damage to the primary target; critical hits double the represented persistent damage.

name: Ghost Charge
description: When a Ghost Charge damages its primary target, apply enfeebled 1 until the start of the attacker's next turn.

name: Nauseating Snare
description: Apply sickened 1/2/3 after a Nauseating Snare Fortitude save succeeds, fails, or critically fails.

name: Stunning Snare
description: Apply stunned 1/2/4 from a Stunning Snare Reflex save outcome; the snare's concurrent off-guard rider remains manual.

name: Rattling Bolt
description: After a Rattling Bolt damages its target, apply deafened and stupefied 1 for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save, or for 1 minute on a critical failure.

name: Setup Snare
description: When a Setup Snare's save is failed or critically failed, apply clumsy 1 until the target's next turn; the snare's push remains manual.

name: Rending Snare
description: Apply off-guard on a successful Rending Snare Reflex save, or clumsy 2 on a failed or critically failed save; failure also creates 2d6 persistent bleed.

name: Bola Shot
description: On a critical success with Bola Shot against the target's Reflex DC, apply prone and stunned 1.

name: Bloodseeker Beak
description: After an attack using Bloodseeker Beak hits an off-guard creature, create 1d4 persistent bleed damage; the talisman's extra precision damage remains manual.

name: Atrophy Bomb
description: When an Atrophy Bomb hits, apply enfeebled 1 until the start of the target's next turn; higher-grade scaling and bomb damage remain manual.

name: Robe of the Erinys (Major)
description: On a critical failure against the robe's activated Fortitude save, apply sickened 1 for 1 round.

name: Frost Vial (Greater)
description: When a Frost Vial hits with its Strike, apply slowed 1 to the target until the end of the attacker's next turn; bomb damage and scaling remain manual.

name: Glue Bomb (Greater)
description: On a critical hit with a Greater Glue Bomb, apply immobilized for 1 round; its Speed penalty, Escape DC, and activation remain manual.

name: Skunk Bomb (Moderate)
description: Apply sickened 1 on a successful Skunk Bomb save, sickened 1 and slowed 1 on a failure, or blinded 1 round, sickened 2, and slowed 1 on a critical failure; splash targeting and odor remain manual.

name: Dream Pollen Snare
description: On a successful Will save against a Dream Pollen Snare, apply stupefied 1 for 1 round; the snare's friendly behavior, duration, and immunity remain manual.

name: Mud Bomb (Greater)
description: On a critical hit with a Greater Mud Bomb, apply dazzled until the start of the attacker's next turn; bomb damage, splash, and activation remain manual.

name: Greater Fearsome
description: When a weapon with the Greater Fearsome rune critically hits, apply frightened 2 to the target; weapon selection and other critical-hit effects remain native/manual.

name: Thorn Triad (Greater)
description: After a plant spell is activated through a Greater Thorn Triad, apply 1d6 persistent bleed to qualifying Strikes until the end of the next turn; activation and duration cleanup remain manual.

name: Wand of Wearying Dance
description: When the wand's Uncontrollable Dance spell produces a successful, failed, or critically failed save, apply off-guard; the spell's reaction restriction, Speed reduction, sustain, and activation remain manual.

name: Horn of Blasting
description: On a Horn of Blasting Fortitude save failure, apply deafened; the horn's sonic damage, 2d6-round duration, and activation mode remain manual.

name: Stampede Medallion
description: On a Stampede Medallion critical-failure Reflex save, apply prone; the emanation, damage, eidolon requirement, and activation frequency remain manual.

name: Bloodburn Censer
description: On a Bloodburn Censer Fortitude save failure, apply enfeebled 2; on a critical failure, apply enfeebled 3. Persistent damage choice and temporary immunity remain manual.

name: Necrobinding Serum
description: On a Necrobinding Serum failed Will save, apply friendly; on a critical failure, apply helpful. Undead-only targeting, duration, mental restrictions, and the success attack penalty remain manual.

name: Stumbling Fulu
description: On a Stumbling Fulu Reflex-save failure, apply clumsy 1; on a critical failure, apply clumsy 2 and prone. Stride triggering, affixed-armor targeting, and Interact cleanup remain manual.

name: Beguiling Crown
description: On a Beguiling Crown Will-save failure or critical failure, apply friendly to the affected creature. Attack-trigger sequencing, activation frequency, duration, and the crown's automatic attitude aura remain manual.

name: Alcohol
description: On an Alcohol critical-failure Fortitude save, apply off-guard from the affliction's flat-footed stage. Onset, later stages, duration, immunity, and recovery remain manual.

name: Warcaller's Chime of Dread
description: On a Warcaller's Chime of Dread Will-save failure, apply frightened 1; on a critical failure, apply frightened 2. Emanation placement, activation, and temporary immunity remain manual.

name: Warcaller's Chime of Blasting
description: On a Warcaller's Chime of Blasting Fortitude-save failure or critical failure, apply prone. Emanation placement, sonic damage, activation, and save adjustments remain manual.

name: Ice Slick Snare
description: On an Ice Slick Snare Reflex-save failure or critical failure, apply prone after the snare's cold damage. Snare placement, trigger timing, and damage remain manual.

name: Spun Cloud (Red)
description: On a Spun Cloud (Red) Will-save failure, apply frightened 2; on a critical failure, apply frightened 3. Cloud placement, activation, temporary immunity, and the spell-like area remain manual.

name: Alluring Scarf
description: On an Alluring Scarf Will-save failure, apply fascinated for 1 round. The Stride area, movement toward the scarf, Sustain, repeat saves, and fascination cleanup remain manual.

name: Growth Gun
description: On a Growth Gun attack hit, apply slowed 1 for 1 round. The activation, once-per-minute frequency, ranged Strike, damage, and growth removal remain manual.

name: Injigo's Loving Embrace
description: On an Injigo's Loving Embrace Reflex-save failure, apply immobilized for 1 round. Incorporeal targeting, activation, Sustain, Escape, and net handling remain manual.

name: Murderer's Knot
description: On a Murderer's Knot qualifying Strike hit, apply off-guard for 1 round. The off-guard prerequisite, persistent bleed amount, bleed-based duration, activation, and Twist the Knife interaction remain manual.

name: Major Rooting
description: Apply immobilized after a critical Major Rooting rune hit; Escape and weapon selection remain manual.

name: True Rooting
description: Apply immobilized after a critical True Rooting rune hit; Escape and weapon selection remain manual.

name: Dread Ampoule
description: Apply frightened 1 after a hit and the stronger fear branch manually on a critical hit; splash and immunity remain manual.

name: Thundering

name: Flickering
description: Apply dazzled after a critical Flickering weapon hit; visual targeting and activation remain manual.

name: Dreaming Round
description: Apply slowed and fatigued after the Dreaming Round save; repeated saves and unconsciousness remain manual.

name: Medusa's Scream

name: Medusa's Scream (Greater)
description: On a Greater Medusa's Scream Fortitude save, apply slowed 1 on a failure and petrified on a critical failure; gaze targeting, damage, escalating saves, and recovery remain manual.

name: Spun Cloud (Green)

name: Immovable

name: Peshpine Grenade (Major)
description: On a hit with a Peshpine Grenade (Major), apply stupefied 1 until the target's next turn ends; splash damage and bomb scaling remain native.

name: Spirit-Sealing Fulu

name: Tenderizer Grenade (Greater)
description: On a successful Tenderizer Grenade (Greater) Strike, apply off-guard until the end of the target's next turn; the critical-hit duration, damage, and resistance reduction remain manual.

name: Necrotic Cap (Major)
description: When a Major Necrotic Cap augments a successful Acid Grip attack, apply enfeebled 4; the catalyst requirement, void damage conversion, sickened rider, and persistent duration remain manual.

name: Brightbloom Posy
description: After a qualifying Strike with pollen from a Brightbloom Posy, apply sickened 1 on a hit and sickened 2 on a critical hit; plant-spell activation, the next-Strike gate, recovery checks, and plant immunity remain manual.

name: Cloak of Illusions
description: When the Cloak of Illusions hood activation is used, apply invisible for 10 minutes; drawing the hood, dismissal, and the item's normal spell duration remain manual.

name: Temperbrand

name: Desiccating Scepter
description: On a Desiccating Scepter Fortitude save, apply slowed 1 on a failure or slowed 2 on a critical failure; damage, usage limits, and water-targeting behavior remain manual.

name: Marking Snare
description: On a critical failure against a Marking Snare Reflex save, apply blinded for 1 round; the snare's marking and tracking benefits remain manual.

name: Death Coil
description: On a Death Coil Fortitude save, apply stunned 2 on a failure or stunned 4 on a critical failure; electricity damage and activation timing remain manual.

name: Mudrock Snare
description: On a Mudrock Snare Fortitude save, apply stunned 2 on a failure; on a critical failure apply stunned 3 and immobilized for 1 minute. Speed penalties, Escape, and placement remain manual.

name: Greater Rooting
description: On a critical hit with a Greater Rooting weapon, apply immobilized and clumsy 1 for 1 round; the Escape DC, critical-hit qualification, and exact end-of-turn timing remain manual.

name: Nightmare

name: Greater Thundering

name: Greater Giant-Killing
description: On the Fortitude save caused by a Greater Giant-Killing critical hit, apply enfeebled 1 on a critical success, enfeebled 2 on a success or failure, and enfeebled 4 on a critical failure; giant targeting, save DC, mental damage, and exact end-of-turn timing remain manual.

name: Disrupting
description: On a critical hit with a Disrupting weapon against an undead or negative-healing target, apply enfeebled 1 for 1 round; undead qualification, vitality persistent damage, and exact end-of-turn timing remain manual.

name: Greater Disrupting
description: On a critical hit with a Greater Disrupting weapon against an undead or negative-healing target, apply enfeebled 1 and stupefied 1 for 1 round; target qualification, vitality persistent damage, and exact persistence duration remain manual.

name: Frost

name: Wounding

name: Atrophy Bomb (Greater)

name: Corrosive

name: Battering Snare

name: Bristling Spines (Moderate)

name: Bloodbane
description: On a successful Bloodbane attack against its appropriate ancestral enemy, apply 1d6 persistent bleed; creature qualification, weapon damage, and the follow-up sickened save remain manual.

name: Bloody Fang
description: On a failed or critically failed Bloody Fang Sweeping Slash Reflex save, apply 1d6 persistent bleed; activation, cone targeting, slashing damage, and the successful-save branch remain manual.

name: Unholy Plate

name: Jolt Coil
description: After a successful Jolt Coil Strike, roll the coil's additional 1d4 electricity damage; activation, resistance, and the end-of-next-turn cutoff remain manual.

name: Nail Bomb (Moderate)
description: After a successful Nail Bomb (Moderate) Strike, roll its 4d4 piercing damage; activation, splash damage, item bonus, and grade handling remain manual.

name: Anathema Fulu
description: On an Anathema Fulu Fortitude-save failure, apply sickened 2 until the start of the target's next turn; trait selection, four-piece placement, banishment interaction, and temporary immunity remain manual.

name: Blindpepper Tube

name: Dazing Coil
description: After a Dazing Coil Will-save failure, apply stunned 1; on a critical failure, apply stunned 2. Affixing, the damage-to-flat-footed trigger, and activation remain manual.

name: Battle Cry

name: Dazzling Display

name: Combat Grab

name: Disorienting Opening

name: Snagging Strike
description: When Snagging Strike hits, apply off-guard to the target for 1 round.

name: Tumble Behind

name: Polished Distraction
description: Apply dazzled, blinded, and their outcome-dependent durations from a Polished Distraction Fortitude save; area, visibility, immunity, and self-immunity remain manual.

name: Dirty Trick
description: Apply clumsy 1 after a successful Dirty Trick Thievery check; critical success lasts until the impediment is Interacted away, while ordinary success lasts 1 round.

name: Irradiate
description: Apply sickened 1 on a failed Irradiate Fortitude save, sickened 2 on a critical failure, and fatigued for 1 minute on a critical failure; aura, scaling, damage, and self-immunity remain manual.

name: Whirling Throw
description: When a qualifying Whirling Throw Athletics check critically succeeds, apply prone to the thrown target; grabbing requirements, distance, damage, and release handling remain manual.

name: Crashing Slam
description: When a qualifying Crashing Slam Strike succeeds, apply prone to the target from the feat's automatic critical Trip effect; weapon prerequisites, damage, and exact MAP handling remain manual.

name: Head Stomp
description: When a qualifying Head Stomp unarmed attack succeeds, apply off-guard to the prone target through the end of the feat user's next turn; prone targeting and exact cleanup timing remain manual.

name: Furious Grab
description: When a qualifying Furious Grab Strike succeeds, apply grabbed to the foe as the feat's automatic Grapple success; rage, free-hand, and Escape handling remain manual.

name: Stunning Fist
description: On a Stunning Fist Fortitude save failure, apply stunned 1; on a critical failure, apply stunned 3. The Flurry of Blows two-Strike requirement, incapacitation adjustment, and damage gate remain manual.

name: Vicious Debilitations
description: After a qualifying Vicious Debilitations attack, apply clumsy 1 to the target when the clumsy debilitation is selected. The required Debilitating Strike, ruffian racket, debilitation choice, and alternate physical weakness option remain manual.

name: Wolf Drag
description: On a successful Wolf Drag Strike, apply prone to the target. The Wolf Stance prerequisite, fatal d12 upgrade, damage, and exact weapon qualification remain manual.

name: Bleeding Finisher
description: After a successful Bleeding Finisher Strike, apply persistent bleed to the target. The feat's finisher requirement, slashing/piercing requirement, and persistent damage scaling remain manual.

name: Brutal Crush
description: After a qualifying Brutal Crush Strike succeeds, apply stupefied 2; on a critical success, apply stupefied 4. The preceding bludgeoning morph or polymorph unarmed Strike and attack prerequisites remain manual.

name: Bloody Denial
description: On a Bloody Denial Fortitude save failure, apply stunned 1; on a critical failure, apply stunned 2. The triggering hit, guardian save DC, and the feat's special critical-success adjustment remain manual.

name: Calcifying Sand
description: On a Calcifying Sand Fortitude save failure, apply slowed 1; on a critical failure, apply petrified. The reaction trigger, physical resistance, one-hour frequency, and exact petrified duration remain manual.

name: Dragging Strike
description: On a successful Dragging Strike attack, apply off-guard to the target until the end of the current turn. Size eligibility, movement, and press-action prerequisites remain manual.

name: Startling Appearance
description: On a successful Startling Appearance Strike, apply off-guard for the rest of the turn and frightened 1; a critical success increases frightened to 2. Unnoticed and emotion-immunity prerequisites remain manual.

name: Parting Shot
description: On a Parting Shot ranged Strike, apply off-guard to the target for the attack. The required loaded/reload-0 ranged weapon and Step are handled manually.

name: Overwhelming Blow
description: When Overwhelming Blow is used, apply stunned 1 and off-guard to the attacker until the start of its next turn, whether or not the Strike hits. The three-action activity and deadly-d12 critical-hit rider remain manual.

name: Flinging Blow
description: On a Flinging Blow Fortitude save failure or critical failure, apply prone to the target. The preceding unarmed Strike, push distance, damage, and exact activity prerequisites remain manual.

name: Whirling Knockdown
description: On a Whirling Knockdown Reflex check critical success, apply prone to the target. The required loaded firearm and melee weapon, preceding ranged Strike, reach, damage, and follow-up check timing remain manual.

name: Coordinated Distraction
description: When Coordinated Distraction is used, apply off-guard to the chosen ally for its next Strike. The ally selection, range, auditory and visual requirements, and first-Strike expiration remain manual.

name: Banishing Blow
description: When Banishing Blow's Athletics check critically succeeds, apply stunned 1 to the fiend. The champion reaction trigger, fiend targeting, Shove check, teleport prevention, and banishment duration remain manual.

name: Aggressive Block
description: When Aggressive Block is used with Shield Block, apply off-guard to the affected adjacent creature until the start of the feat user's next turn. The size, adjacency, Shove choice, and obstacle handling remain manual.

name: Flashing Shield
description: When Flashing Shield is used with Shield Block against an adjacent undead creature, apply off-guard for 1 round. The undead and adjacency requirements, vitality damage, and faith prerequisite remain manual.

name: Cornered Fury
description: When a foe larger than the Cornered Fury user critically hits and damages them, apply off-guard to the feat user for 1 round. The foe's size, damage confirmation, and ancestry eligibility remain manual.

name: First to Strike, Fall
description: When the First to Strike, Fall user successfully Strikes a creature that has not acted in the first round, apply off-guard to that creature until the end of the user's next turn. First-round activity, target eligibility, and the feat's additional rewards remain manual.

name: Dazzling Bullet
description: After a Dazzling Bullet Performance check succeeds, apply dazzled for 1 round to the target. The required damaging firearm Strike and Pistol Phenom prerequisites remain manual.

name: Tiger Stance

name: Felling Strike

name: Stumbling Stance
description: After an enemy hits the Stumbling Stance user with a melee Strike, apply off-guard to that attacker for 1 round. The stance requirement and restriction to the user's next stumbling swing remain manual.

name: Twin Feint
description: After a successful Twin Feint Strike, apply off-guard to the target for the follow-up Strike. The two-weapon requirement and exact first/second Strike sequencing remain manual.

name: Twin Distraction
description: On a failed Twin Distraction Will save, apply stupefied 1 until the end of the user's next turn. The requirement that both Twin Feint Strikes deal damage and the exact duration timing remain manual.

name: Disarming Twist
description: On a failed Disarming Twist Strike, apply off-guard to the target until the end of the current turn. The one-handed weapon requirement, disarm success effects, and exact end-of-turn cleanup remain manual.

name: Brutish Shove
description: After a successful Brutish Shove Strike, apply off-guard to the target until the end of the current turn. The size qualification and automatic Shove movement remain manual.

name: Emotional Push
description: When Emotional Push is used after an enemy fails a save against an emotion spell, apply off-guard to that enemy until the end of the user's next turn. The reaction timing and next-attack restriction remain manual.

name: Silence the Profane
description: After a successful Silence the Profane Strike, apply off-guard to the spellcaster until the end of the user's next turn. The reaction trigger, favored-weapon requirement, and spell disruption remain manual.

name: Delay Trap
description: On a critical failure of the Delay Trap Thievery check, apply off-guard to the user until the start of the user's next turn. The trap trigger, reaction timing, and successful delay outcomes remain manual.

name: Bound in Ice
description: When Bound in Ice's qualifying Fortitude save fails, apply stunned 1 to the creature entering the user's space. The discorporation state, once-per-round frequency, movement trigger, and cold damage remain manual.

name: Debilitating Strike
description: Apply enfeebled 1 after Debilitating Strike; prerequisites remain manual.

name: Animate Net
description: Apply off-guard after Animate Net; immobilization remains manual.

name: Hot Foot
description: Apply off-guard for 1 round after Hot Foot; prerequisites remain manual.

name: Disarming Flair

name: You're Next

name: Sickening Strike

name: Pinning Fire

name: Confusing Commands

name: Frightening Power

name: Twirling Strike

name: Shove Down

name: Evangelize

name: Distracting Feint
description: After a successful Distracting Feint, apply off-guard to the target for 1 round. The Feint action, target restrictions, and exact attack scope remain manual.
